        class FakeBackend:
            def __init__(self):
                self.calls = []

            def complete(
                self,
                system,
                user,
                *,
                json_mode=True,
            ):
                self.calls.append(user)
                if len(self.calls) == 1:
                    return ""
                if len(self.calls) == 2:
                    return '{"tool":"append_file","args":{"path":"todo.py"}}'
                return json.dumps(
                    {
                        "tool": "append_file",
                        "args": {
                            "path": "todo.py",
                            "content": "new content",
                        },
                    }
                )

        large_called = {"value": False}

            def complete(
                self,
                system,
                user,
                *,
                json_mode=True,
            ):
                large_called["value"] = True
                return json.dumps(
                    {"tool": "list_files", "args": {}}

            return LargeBackend()
